Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent PNG fruit sprite for a physics puzzle game. Create ONE fruit character, 512x512 square canvas. Match the supplied reference images only in glossy colorful 3D cartoon illustration style, large expressive brown eyes with white highlights, little happy open smiling mouth, gentle rosy cheeks, warm upper-left lighting and dark subtly colored edge outline.
CRITICAL GEOMETRY: the entire outer silhouette must be ONE MATHEMATICALLY PERFECT CIRCLE centered exactly at canvas center, diameter 96% of canvas width and height, equal x/y diameter. Not an oval. Give depth by spherical shading while preserving the exact circular contour.
Transparent background with genuine alpha outside the circle, no background color, no checkerboard drawn, no cast shadow, no halo, no extra objects, no limbs, no text, no watermark. Front orthographic view, eyes near mid-height, mouth lower center, facial proportions consistent across the fruit set.
